file_type: PE32+ (x86-64) console executable, MinGW-w64 GCC 13, unstripped with full DWARF debug info

injection_details.method: Ghost Process Hollowing: NtCreateProcess (with NULL SectionHandle -> sectionless process with no image on disk) + NtAllocateVirtualMemory (MEM_COMMIT|MEM_RESERVE, PAGE_EXECUTE_READWRITE 0x40) + NtWriteVirtualMemory + NtCreateThreadEx (StartRoutine = allocated base) + NtResumeThread
injection_details.target_process: A brand-new child process created by the malware itself via NtCreateProcess (no existing system process is targeted)
injection_details.target_discovery: No discovery/enumeration: it opens a handle to itself with OpenProcess(PROCESS_CREATE_PROCESS=0x80, FALSE, GetCurrentProcessId()) and passes it as the ParentProcess argument to NtCreateProcess
injection_details.payload_write: 64-byte payload decrypted in-memory by xor_crypt (stack buffer), then written into the remote RWX region with NtWriteVirtualMemory; thread entry point set to the allocation base; waits via WaitForSingleObject(thread, 5000 ms) and closes handles with NtClose

encryption_details.algorithm: XOR (repeating multi-byte key): buf[i] ^= key[i % keylen], keylen=0x12 (18)
encryption_details.key_storage: Plaintext in .rdata at VA 0x140004000 (global g_xor_key), immediately followed by plaintext "ntdll.dll" and the NT API name strings; encrypted payload at .data VA 0x140003000 (g_encrypted_payload, 0x40 bytes)

decoded_strings.decrypted_payload_ascii_prefix: mdemsnillq (remainder non-printable filler; appears to be a dummy placeholder payload, not valid x86-64 code)
decoded_strings.debug_artifacts: Source file windows_level21_GhostProcessHollowing.c; symbols xor_crypt, g_xor_key, g_encrypted_payload, resolve_nt, anti_debug_nt, ghost_hollow

anti_analysis: NtQueryInformationProcess ProcessDebugPort (class 7): debugger detected if returned port == -1 (0xFFFFFFFF)
NtQueryInformationProcess ProcessDebugFlags (class 0x1F/31): debugger detected if flags == 0
Silent exit (return 0 from WinMain) when a debugger is detected
Runtime resolution of all native NT APIs via GetModuleHandleA("ntdll.dll") + GetProcAddress so the import table hides the injection primitives
Use of undocumented native NT API (NtCreateProcess/NtCreateThreadEx) instead of Win32 equivalents
